notes.title: Update: Climbable barrels, improved graphics, pressure sensitivity refinements
notes.notes:
In the LA and night time environments you'll now find barrels you can grab and drop to climb on to reach higher areas of the wall. Grab using left grip - teleport has been reassigned to right touch pad.

Some users reported the trigger dead zone being too narrow which resulted in a constantly spraying can. The dead zone is now much wider.

The lower two quality levels for the game had perfectly flat walls (no normal maps) - these levels have been removed. Any users that were unknowingly stuck on these levels will see massive graphical improvements.

notes.title: Update: Pressure sensitivity feature and destructive actions rework
notes.notes:
You can now toggle between pressure sensitive and slider controlled cap tweak using right grip. In pressure sensitive mode cap tweak will be controlled by the amount you press down on the trigger, in manual mode, you can set cap tweak using the slider. Pressure sensitive mode will be the default and offers a less precise but more natural way to control cap tweak.

The only possibly destructive action remaining on the left hand directional pad is undo, which requires a hard press rather than touch now. Resolution scaling has been moved into the wall manager panel. This is the result of feedback from many users who found it difficult to avoid accidentally triggering destructive actions.

notes.title: New release, patch notes, and leaving early access
notes.notes:
Patch Notes

     New subway environment

     Color picker (light right press, use can to aim)

     Images on menu now show your latest save snapshot
     2 instances of each wall for each environment
     Snapshot resolution increased
     Better icons for radial menu
     Alpha is now stripped from saves (documents folder)
     Pressing the menu button to leave to the menu now requires confirmation
     New notification system
     Curved color swatche icons

notes.title: Next Update: Single step undo and refinements to spray interpolation
notes.notes: The next update will include improvements relating to spray smoothness and also introduce a single step undo feature which keeps things fairly realistic while allowing a single undo in the event of tracking loss and other situations which would otherwise ruin your progress. I'll release in the next few days.

notes.notes:
Spray particle effects

    Old color wheel couldn't achieve some colors so is replaced by HSV sliders
    Improved spray sounds - no more mechanical looping
